home.metaTitle: Munduk Hiking Guide | Twin Lakes Treks with Ketut Darma
home.metaDescription: Private hikes around Lake Buyan, Lake Tamblingan and the Munduk waterfalls with Ketut Darma, a local guide in North Bali. Book easily on WhatsApp.
home.heroHeadline: Hike Munduk's Twin Lakes with a local guide
home.heroText: Private treks through the forest around Lake Buyan and Lake Tamblingan, down to Munduk's waterfalls and through the clove gardens between the villages. Small groups, your pace, booked on WhatsApp.

whyChoose.title: A local guide from the highlands
whyChoose.text: Ketut lives and works around Munduk. He knows which trails are dry after rain, where the views open up, and which warung serves the best coffee.

whyChoose.title: Private, never a crowd
whyChoose.text: Every hike is just you and your group. Walk at your own pace, stop for photos, and ask anything along the way.

whyChoose.title: Clear prices, no surprises
whyChoose.text: Each hike lists what's included and what isn't, so you know the price before you message.

whyChoose.title: Easy booking on WhatsApp
whyChoose.text: Send your date and group size. Ketut replies personally to confirm your hike and pickup time.
